observations.lookup: Reject null/empty; sort table by filename; binary case-insensitive lookup; update cached index. Missing and load=true calls AddBitmap(filename,false).
observations.addFile: Checks existing entry before filesystem resolution. Uses file resolver (override or FindFileImpl); reads complete encoded file into owned memory; new/existing entry stores ON_EmbeddedBitmap original requested filename, byte size, owned bytes, CRC32 and fresh UUID. Bitmap cache presence does not prove decoding succeeds. Existing replacement payload cleanup occurs only after file read succeeds.
observations.dib: Embedded payload converts through CRhinoDib::ReadFromMemory; optional caller DIB versus allocated result has different cleanup on decode failure. Existing ON_WindowsBitmap BITMAPINFO uses SetDib(false); newly inspected SetDib proves its destination allocation/copy, not retained aliasing of the source buffer.
observations.decode: Null/empty rejects. L_LoadBitmapMemory, positive result then L_ChangeToDIB/GlobalLock/RhinoUiDIBCopy; only after successful copy is old DIB destroyed and new DIB installed. Failed SetDib frees copied memory. Existing selected bitmap may be refreshed. -9 load error prints a diagnostic. Exact imported codec flags and bit-depth policy remain to disassemble.
observations.codec: Original decoder imports by ordinal: Ltfil15x.dll #67 L_LoadBitmapMemory and Ltkrn15x.dll #11 L_ChangeToDIB, confirmed against static export tables and original DLL hashes. Windows decoder dependency is separate from portable arithmetic; no original DLL executed.
observations.setDib: Null input destroys destination and returns0. Creates palette and destination DIB from source width/height/bitcount; copies pixel storage only when calculated source and destination byte counts match. Return reflects nonnull CreateDib, not a separate pixel-copy success flag. On successful creation, bool=true frees input through configured allocator/onfree; false leaves caller input owned by caller. Failed creation does not free input. Previous palette is released.
observations.copyDib: RhinoUiDIBCopy creates new DIB of source dimensions/bitcount, derives palette count from explicit clrUsed or bitdepth1/4/8 defaults2/16/256, validates matching nonzero pixel-storage byte counts, then copies palette and bits. On mismatch/zero storage frees new allocation and returns null. Does not establish arbitrary compressed/top-down/header/profile format equivalence.
observations.storageSize: GetStorageSize returns GetStorageWidth()*Height() in unsigned32 result; grayscale processes floor(result/3) triples. Managed raster receives a bounded explicit span and avoids unsafe signed/unsigned allocation arithmetic.

next: Implement local bounded encoded-byte asset ownership separate from real Apple decode success. Acquire real supported-format fixtures, characterize original codec conversion/pixel behavior, then ImageIO/Metal integration. Do not emulate cache presence as successful decode or execute original Windows codec DLLs.

decoderAbi.loadBitmapMemory: Win64 RCX=encoded bytes; RDX=stack bitmap struct; R8D=0xd4 struct size; R9D=0; stack arg5=1,arg6=encoded byte count,arg7=0,arg8=0. Exact named option semantics not inferred without matching version headers.
decoderAbi.changeToDib: RCX=bitmap struct; EDX=0. Returns global-memory handle consumed through GlobalLock/copy/unlock/free.
